decision_points.condition: Based on several conditions (a-g), UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST. If timer T3502 is running, stop timer T3502. If timer T3511 is running, stop timer T3511.
Multiple conditions (a-g) determine which identity (5G-GUTI, SUCI, PEI) is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
If SUCI is included and T3519 is not running, start T3519 and store SUCI; include stored SUCI while T3519 is running.
decision_points.timer: Starts Timer T3519 if SUCI is included and timer T3519 is not running.
decision_points.fallback: Include stored SUCI in REGISTRATION REQUEST message while timer T3519 is running.

decision_points.condition: Network may initiate identification, authentication, and security procedures based on the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

During emergency registration, the AMF may skip the authentication procedure even if no 5G NAS security context is available if the AMF is configured to support emergency registration for unauthenticated SUCIs.

decision_points.step: Initial registration accepted by the network (5.5.1.2.4)
decision_points.condition: If initial registration request is accepted, AMF sends REGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.
The AMF may include a list of equivalent PLMNs/SNPNs. The UE takes action to store, remove, or delete the list based on the message content and the UE's forbidden PLMN list.
Based on the LADN indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, UE subscription information, UE location and local configuration about LADN, the AMF determines the LADN DNNs for the UE.

If the UE supports WUS assistance information and the AMF supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance information for the UE, the AMF shall determine the negotiated UE paging probability information for the UE

If AMF has not allocated a new 5G-GUTI by the generic UE configuration update procedure, the AMF shall include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message the new assigned 5G-GUTI together with the assigned TAI list.

If a 5G-GUTI or the SOR transparent container IE or Operator-defined access category definitions IE or the Extended emergency number list IE, the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE or the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE or UE radio capability ID IE or UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE is included in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, the AMF shall start timer T3550 and enter state 5GMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
If MICO mode is supported and accepted, AMF may indicate 'all PLMN registration area allocated' and omit the TAI list.
Upon receipt of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, the UE reset registration attempt counter, enter state 5GMM-REGISTERED and set the 5GS update status to 5U1 UPDATED

decision_points.step: UE Receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT (Network slicing change and need REGISTRATION COMPLETE) (5.5.1.2.4)
decision_points.condition: If the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains with the Network slicing indication IE with the Network slicing subscription change, or Configured NSSAI IE with a new configured NSSAI, or CAG IE , the UE needs to return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF.
If UE requests SMS over NAS and SMSF selection is successful, set SMS allowed bit; otherwise, set SMS allowed bit to 'SMS over NAS not allowed'.

Complex conditions determine if NSSAA is required, allowed NSSAI and pending NSSAI are provided, or rejected NSSAI is indicated based on UE support and network slice-specific authentication and authorization requirements.

decision_points.step: Timer Start when Receiving REGISTRATION COMPLETE (5.5.1.2.4)
decision_points.condition: Upon receiving a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message, the AMF shall stop timer T3550 and change to state 5GMM-REGISTERED. The 5G-GUTI, if sent in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, shall be considered as valid, the PEIPS assistance information, if sent in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, shall be considered as valid, and the UE radio capability ID, if sent in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT, shall be considered as valid.
Based on UE and network capabilities, parameters such as IWK N26, IMS voice over PS session indicator, MPS/MCS indicators, and RestrictEC are handled.
If initial registration request can't be accepted, AMF sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE including an appropriate 5GMM cause value. Congestion lead to starting T3346

If UE supports extended rejected NSSAI and the AMF determines that maximum number of UEs reached for one or more S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI as specified in subclause 4.6.2.5, the AMF shall include the rejected NSSAI containing one or more S-NSSAIs with the rejection cause 'S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached' in the Extended rejected NSSAI IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message. In addition, the AMF may include a back-off timer value for each S-NSSAI with the rejection cause 'S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached' in the Extended rejected NSSAI IE of the REGISTRATION REJECT message
If the registration request is rejected because of CAG restrictions, the AMF includes the 'CAG information list' IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message.

decision_points.step: UE Takes Action based on REGISTRATION REJECT message cause and condition
decision_points.condition: Based on different 5GMM cause values the UE shall act according to bullet j) of subclause 5.5.1.2.8

If there is one or more S-NSSAIs in the rejected NSSAI with the rejection cause 'S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached', then for each S-NSSAI, the UE shall stop the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI, if running.The UE start the timer T3526 with the value specified. the UE remove the S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached when the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI expires.
On REGISTRATION REJECT for emergency services, UE performs actions from 5.5.1.2.5 and informs upper layers.
Multiple abnormal cases (e.g., T3510 timeout, lower layer failure) lead to the UE aborting registration and potentially entering a deregistered state with retries.
Timer T3346 is running, the UE shall not start the registration procedure for initial registration unless the different condition are met

decision_points.step: The lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred
decision_points.condition: The UE shall not start the initial registration procedure. The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process

The UE shall abort the registration procedure for initial registration and the NAS signalling connection, if any, shall be released locally if the initial registration request is neither for emergency services nor for initiating a PDU session for emergency services with request type set to 'existing emergency PDU session'.

Timer T3447 is running, the UE shall not start the registration procedure for initial registration with Follow-on request indicator set to 'Follow-on request pending' unless the different condition are met
Multiple abnormal cases (e.g., lower layer failure, protocol error, T3550 timeout) lead to the AMF aborting or retrying the procedure.

decision_points.step: Lower layer failure before REGISTRATION COMPLETE
decision_points.condition: AMF locally aborts the procedure and considers both the old and new 5G-GUTI as valid.

If the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is received with a protocol error, the AMF shall return a REGISTRATION REJECT message with one of the following 5GMM cause values: #96 invalid mandatory information, #99 information element non-existent or not implemented, #100 conditional IE error or #111 protocol error, unspecified
